typed-files.reason: src/content.config.ts of the site imports astro:content, a module that only the Astro build makes.

typed-scripts.reason: release.yml and the pack scripts are owned by the release process. The files of image/ and targets/ run in containers with no build, on Node.js or a shell. The tests start the files of packages/service/test/ as child processes, with no build. The Playwright of shots.mjs comes from PW_DIR, outside the workspace. The Astro build loads astro.config.mjs.

no-local-paths.reason: /home/test is the home folder of the fake host of the tests, not the folder of a real user.

unreleased-change.reason: Each pull request of systems sets the version of each package whose shipped files it changes, and each merge starts a release. On 2026-11-15, two pull requests set service 0.8.18, and the second change did not get to npm (SYS-118). From conventions 0.42.3, an entry of files that git does not track ships only its build inputs. Thus vm/** of the harness and go/** of the prober do not ship, and the default list of unshipped files applies.
